title: Daniel Island Ferry

services.name: Harbor Cruise
services.desc: Chasing the perfect Charleston sunset? Let our captains carry you to it, drink in hand, no planning required. Escape the crowds, leave the traffic behind, and step aboard Daniel Island Ferry for an unforgettable Charleston Sunset Harbor Cruise. Departing from the Daniel Island Waterfront, this relaxing 90-minute cruise takes you through the heart of Charleston Harbor as the sky transforms into brilliant shades of gold, orange, and pink. Whether you're visiting Charleston, planning a romantic date night, celebrating with friends, or simply looking for a peaceful evening on the water, our sunset cruise offers the perfect way to experience the beauty of the Lowcountry.
